commentary_text: fourth stump line outside off on good length, Rahane pushes at it and gets an inside edge to midwicket
139.4kmh, more width for the fullish ball outside off, he middles the drive down to mid off
0.31Starc to Rahane, 1 runin the air, one bounce to deep third! Short and wide, good bounce and Rahane upper-cuts that over the backward point region. Off the mark
beaten! Full and wide, pretty wide, in fact. Allen goes down on a knee and tries to reach for it but misses. Just inside the wide line
bashed down the ground for four! More in his range, no swing really for the length ball and Allen barely moves his feet but smashes the ball back past mid off
0.61Starc to Allen, 1 runhint of late swing for the full ball on off at 143.3kmh, inside edge to leg for one
amazing shot! Not that short, but he hops on the back foot and almost scoops it over the midwicket region with a back-foot loft to find the boundary
header: Axar Patel to Allen, FOUR runs

commentary_text: 1.21Axar Patel to Allen, 1 runstays back again and works it down to long on for one
slower to Rahane on middle and leg and angling in with the arm, he nudges to leg
header: Axar Patel to Rahane, no run

commentary_text: makes room and carves that through the covers! Four more. There was turn this one for the ball turning away from off and Rahane backed away further to free his arms further
header: Axar Patel to Rahane, FOUR runs

commentary_text: 1.51Axar Patel to Rahane, 1 runoutside off and he turns it to leg for one more
1.61Axar Patel to Allen, 1 rungoes on the back foot again and Allen also whips the ball from outside off to leg for one
134kmh, not his usual pace outside off and that gives Allen enough time to stand back and punch that through cover point, right in the gap for four
2.21Starc to Allen, 1 runStarc goes for the inswinging yorker but it's a low full toss, still not a bad ball. Allen drives it wide of mid off but Axar does well to get a hand to it with a dive
141.9kmh beaten! Test match stuff from Starc - stifling line outside off, excellent bounce and pace and Rahane pokes and misses

2.46Starc to Rahane, SIX runsflicked with such flair! The peach is followed by one on the pads and Rahane is not going to let that go. Flicks it all the way into the stands with a flourishing swing of the bat
2.51Starc to Rahane, 1 runhint of inswing and that takes the inside edge of the bat to fine leg

run out at the non-striker's end! Drama in Delhi. Starc is pumped even as Allen apologises to his partner. Starc goes for the Inswinging yorker, Allen slams it back because it's not really in the block hole, Rahane is a couple of steps out and Starc gets his left hand on the ball which hits the stumps at the other endAjinkya Rahane run out (Starc) 13 (9b 1x4 1x6 13m) SR: 144.44
flat and quick on the stumps, he defends on the back foot
header: Axar Patel to A Raghuvanshi, no run

commentary_text: 3.21Axar Patel to A Raghuvanshi, 1 run92.3kmh, fuller on the stumps and Raghuvanshi opens up to drive through cover
header: Axar Patel to A Raghuvanshi,  1 run

commentary_text: 3.31Axar Patel to Allen, 1 runskidding towards top of middle, Allen works it to leg for one more

what a bizarre dismissal! And Raghuvanshi is gone too. Raghuvanshi goes for the sweep and doesn't connect but the ball goes off his arm and lobs up, and then bounces and rolls back to hit the stumps while Raghuvanshi tries to spot the ball and then attempts to move it away but it's too lateAngkrish Raghuvanshi b Patel 1 (3b 0x4 0x6 2m) SR: 33.33
header: Axar Patel to A Raghuvanshi, OUT

commentary_text: 3.51Axar Patel to Green, 1 runoff the mark straightaway with a punch to deep cover
86.7kmh, some pace off for the fourth stump line, he punches straight to cover
header: Axar Patel to Allen, no run

commentary_text: 4.11Ngidi to Green, 1 runpace on to start with, movement off the pitch too and Green steers the ball square to off after it seamed away
135kmh, quick and angling in, he nudges it to midwicket
lovely drive on the up for the full delivery outside off, but straight to mid off
4.41Ngidi to Allen, 1 runtight lines at 137.1kmh, he taps the ball to off and takes off for one
angling in just outside off, pushes to cover with a front foot stride
shorter and angling in towards the body, he defends with a straight bat
5.11Axar Patel to Allen, 1 runon the back foot almost immediately, and clips the ball to leg for one
watches carefully and defends on off
header: Axar Patel to Green, no run

commentary_text: 5.36Axar Patel to Green, SIX runspitched up and that's disappeared into the stands! The ball is lost, not kidding you. Right in the slot and Green used his long limbs to get to it easily and send it 94m away over wide long on
header: Axar Patel to Green,  SIX runs

commentary_text: 5.41Axar Patel to Green, 1 runmakes a hint of room for the length ball on off, punches down to long off for one
on the back foot, darted on off, defends it just in time
header: Axar Patel to Allen, no run

commentary_text: 5.61Axar Patel to Allen, 1 runmuch slower at 83.7kmh on middle stump, he goes back yet again and tucks it to leg for one
6.11Nigam to Allen, 1 runslightly loopy outside off and driven away to long off
6.21Nigam to Green, 1 runshort and flat to Green, who hangs back and turns it to leg for one
flat to Allen as well, but this one has enough room for Allen to free his arms with a cut square of the wicket and beat a diving deep point for four
6.46Nigam to Allen, SIX runsstraight as an arrow and six more! Too straight, too full and Allen cashes in with a straight loft 92 meters away
6.51Nigam to Allen, 1 runmuch quicker and flatter, he cuts it away for one
a wrong'un to end the over, Green stays back and adjusts just in time for one with a late cut
flat and quick from Kuldeep too, Allen slams it to midwicket
edged for four off the wrong'un! This one turns the other away from off stump, Allen punches away and only gets a thick edge but there's no slip and Allen gets four
well outside off, this had to turn towards the batter, who defends it back
7.46Kuldeep to Allen, SIX runsgenerously flighted and that's smashed into the sight screen! Too full as well apart from the flight, and he middled that straight loft

pulled straight down to long on, Stubbs runs in but he's put it down! It wasn't an easy catch at all because the ball was dipping on him, but he did manage to get his hands on the ball before putting it down
googly to end the over too, Green waits deep in the crease and defends
8.11Ngidi to Green, 1 runslower ball it is on short of length outside off, Green scythes to deep point for one
138.6kmh, back to pace on and Allen swings but can't clear midwicket
8.31Ngidi to Allen, 1 run116.8kmh, slower ball dipping towards the block hole well outside off, he drives it down to long off
8.41Ngidi to Green, 1 runpace outside off, another single for Green to deep point, this one with a drive
8.51Ngidi to Allen, 1 runhe gets it in the block hole now, and Allen digs it out for one
8.61Ngidi to Green, 1 run134.9kmh, full on the stumps and Green charges down to slam it down to long off for one
darts one towards middle, Green defends it back
header: Axar Patel to Green, no run

commentary_text: fuller on middle and this one's driven to cover
header: Axar Patel to Green, no run

commentary_text: Green looked unsure whether to come down or stay back and eventually defended it back
header: Axar Patel to Green, no run

commentary_text: 9.42Axar Patel to Green, 2 runsstays back for this one at 95.7kmh and carves it wide of point for two in the gap
9.51Axar Patel to Green, 1 runmakes a bit of room to scythe that one for one more
9.61Axar Patel to Allen, 1 runquick on the back foot again, push down to long on for one

10.16Starc to Allen, SIX runsScrambling scoop to bring up fifty. Pre-meditated, banking on getting pace on. Allen went back in the crease and side-crawled across the crease, got inside the line of a length ball and got it over fine leg
10.21Starc to Allen, 1 runHalf-volley just outside off, munches a drive but straight to long-on
10.32Starc to Green, 2 runsDropped. Tough chance, driven hard to Axar's left. Not as sure on replay actually, ball may have half-volleyed to him.
10.41Starc to Green, 1 runShort of a length slower ball just outside off. Green in great position for the pull, gets it to deep square leg
10.51Starc to Allen, 1 runProper toe-job. Allen too early into the pull as the slow short ball spins away from him. Gets it to long-on. Starc smiles

10.62Starc to Green, 2 runsLow full toss just outside off, driven along the ground to Stubbs' left at long-off. He splashes the ball in front as he was running full tilt as he got behind it. Does well to save two

11.16Kuldeep to Allen, SIX runsGoogly has been pulled over deep midwicket. Kuldeep did miss his length, erred on the shorter side, but at 83ks, the ball just failed to get off the pitch. Allen reached forward and was early on the shot, doesn't matter
11.21Kuldeep to Allen, 1 runFuller side of length just outside off, chopped to long-off. That one spun in and skdded
11.36Kuldeep to Green, SIX runsGreen is much more comfortable on the pull. Over midwicket again. Kuldeep's exasperated. This was shortish too, at the stumps, came off the pitch at an easy pace.
11.41Kuldeep to Green, 1 run87ks length ball just outside off, chopped off the bottom-half to cover
11.51Kuldeep to Allen, 1 runAllen coils back as he cuts hard.
11.61Kuldeep to Green, 1 runFlat and quick. 87ks but looked quicker. At the stumps, Green wanted to work it leg side. Gets it to long-off. Close to the leading edge. Went along the ground
12.11Nigam to Green, 1 runGoes back and works the length ball, against the spin, to long-on
12.26Nigam to Allen, SIX runsLooped up, flighted into the stands. First tier six over long-off. 86 metres. This was full and just outside off, Allen got low and slashed with the spin
12.36Nigam to Allen, SIX runsGood ball punished like it was trash. Flat length ball on top of middle and leg, Allen goes back in the crease, then square-on and pulls it over square leg

12.46Nigam to Allen, SIX runsThird six in a row. Back over long-off again. Axar's double-teapotting. Legbreak is a touch too full and on the same line as the second ball. No spin this time, same shot pretty much
12.51Nigam to Allen, 1 runLength on middle and leg, twirls the front leg out of the way and punches to long-off
12.61Nigam to Green, 1 runLength on leg, clipped through square leg
13.11Kuldeep to Green, 1 runFullish length ball on middle and leg, goes back and flicks to deep-backward square leg

13.26Kuldeep to Allen, SIX runsLength missed, ball flies. Googly is too full and too wide. Allen took a small step forward and used his hands to reach out, not ideal, but this time he muscles it with a flat-bat over long-off
Goes back and works it to midwicket.
13.42Kuldeep to Allen, 2 runsNutmegged? Yep, not French cut. Allen went back in the crease and looked to whip it square again, got it to fine leg
13.56Kuldeep to Allen, SIX runsAllen mercilessly dispatches Kuldeep now. Pitched up outside off, Allen takes a big stride forward and brings out the big slog sweep for a big six over midwicket
Wanted to hit it out of Delhi. Went back in the crease and pulled it with might, too early on it though and toed the length ball to the bowler's left
14.11Mukesh to Green, 1 runYep, Green goes back and glances the short-of-length ball to deep fine leg
14.26Mukesh to Allen, SIX runsMake it four, with a six! Allen pick-up pulls it off a back of length over midwicket. Hugs his partner, lid comes off. KL congratulates him
